why: From figure 1 to figure 2 the outer arc jumps to the opposite side, the straight line changes direction and the small centre circle swaps colour (white to red). In figure 3 the outer arc is on the right and the dot is red, so the answer has the arc on the left, a turned (vertical) line and a white centre: option 1. Options 2 and 4 keep the red dot and the same line, and option 3 keeps the arc on the right.
trick: List every part (arc, line, dot) and apply each change from the example to it.
note: Options 2 and 4 look the same in the scan.
